desc: This is the STU 1 - Ballot version of the De-identification, Anonymization and Redaction Toolkit Services (DARTS) FHIR IG.
title: De-identification, Anonymization and Redaction Toolkit Services (DARTS) FHIR IG
registry-description: The DARTS Implementation Guide defines a deidentification and anonymization services that will be used to create deidentified and anonymized data based on different policies, jurisdictions and applicable regulations
introduction: De-identification, Anonymization and Redaction Toolkit Services (DARTS) FHIR IG defines a set of FHIR operations to de-identify and anonymize identifiable data so that non PII/PHI data can be exchanged.
